Schedule cheap charging at home
When you plug in at home, it picks the cheapest stretch before your departure time and sets the car\'s charging window. Afterwards the car\'s plan goes back to how it was.

PVPC: the hourly prices published by Red Eléctrica (Spain). Three bands: your own price for each band and which band each hour is. Flat rate: a single price (the home electricity price); no window is scheduled.
